title: EffiBench-X: A Multi-Language Benchmark for Measuring Efficiency of LLM-Generated Code
abstract: arXiv:2505.13004v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Existing code generation benchmarks primarily evaluate functional correctness, with limited focus on code efficiency and often restricted to a single language like Python. To address this gap, we introduce EffiBench-X, the first multi-language benchmark designed to measure the efficiency of LLM-generated code. EffiBench-X supports Python, C++, Java, JavaScript, Ruby, and Golang. It comprises competitive programming tasks with human-expert solutions as efficiency baselines. Evaluating state-of-the-art LLMs on EffiBench-X reveals that while models generate functionally correct code, they consistently underperform human experts in efficiency. Even the most efficient LLM-generated solutions (Qwen3-32B) achieve only around \textbf{62\%} of human efficiency on average, with significant language-specific variations. translated_title: EffiBench-X：一个用于衡量LLM生成代码效率的多语言基准
translated_abstract: 现有的代码生成基准主要评估功能正确性，对代码效率的关注有限，且通常仅限于Python等单一语言。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了EffiBench-X，这是首个旨在衡量LLM生成代码效率的多语言基准。EffiBench-X支持Python、C++、Java、JavaScript、Ruby和Golang。该基准由竞赛编程任务组成，并以人类专家的解决方案作为效率基线。在最先进LLM上的评估结果显示，尽管这些模型能够生成功能正确的代码，但它们在效率上始终不及人类专家。即使是最有效的LLM生成方案（Qwen3-32B），其平均效率也仅达到人类效率的约62%，且存在显著的语言特异性差异。LLM在Python、Ruby和JavaScript中的效率表现优于Java、C++和Golang。例如，DeepSeek-R1的Python
tldr: 本文提出首个多语言代码效率基准EffiBench-X，评估发现LLM生成的代码虽然功能正确，但平均效率仅约为人类专家的62%，且在不同编程语言之间存在显著的效率差异。
